title: Written in Your DNA
sentences: The Black Death may still be written in your DNA.
In 2022, scientists studied ancient DNA from people who lived before and after the plague.
Certain immune gene variants became more common after it.
They may have helped people survive.
But those same variants are linked to some autoimmune diseases today.
Other scientists have since challenged that finding, so the debate goes on.
